t: Stylish, all-chrome dual-headed TMV2 shower suitable for all the family. Ceramic disc flow thermostatic temperature control constantly regulates the water temperature giving the user more precise control and safer showering. Flow and temperature are controlled separately, giving precise control of both. Diverter can change water flow from a fixed position showerhead to a flexible handset. Exposed valve is mounted onto the finished wall surface and not built into the wall. Suitable for high pressure water systems only. Supplied with surface fixing brackets and 1.25m anti-twist.
b: Suitable for High Pressure Water Systems Only
